limitations: A row is not a checklist pass. All source-declared controls remain UNVERIFIED until actual required states are exercised.
Functional observation columns state only the exercised subset and evidence build; they do not change parity status.
FAIL feature rows preserve known incomplete/missing implementation; only user/product owner can authorize deliberate differences.
Exact Adobe visual identity remains UNVERIFIED for every applicable row without matched licensed reference captures.
NOT_APPLICABLE rows are CS6 Extended or post-CS6 baseline scope determinations; separately shipped extensions still require functional verification.
The 125-family historical matrix is not an exhaustive enumeration of the missing Adobe interface. Missing authorized reference prevents claiming a complete Adobe state denominator.
